text: Backlog split from specs/scale-space-energy-plan.md. Milestone 1 is the low-level scanner: image/stat contracts, deterministic resampling, scale_space spec with identity/global endpoints, Gaussian smoother, signed/local energy channels, two-pass studentization, max-null FWER, result summaries, plots, and validation. Later motes cover raw-image wrappers, repeated-measures contrasts, GLM/Freedman-Lane, graph heat/adjoin borrowing, effective basis, optional positive/band-pass channels, and vignette docs.
